plan.prompt:
Extract only the URL from this text. Reply with the URL only — nothing else.

{search_plan}

reason.prompt:
Target: {target_name}

Search angle: {search_plan}

Page content from {search_url}:
{page_content}

Extract every fact relevant to whereabouts, location, appearances, events, travel, or schedule:
- Specific dates, cities, venues, country
- Event names, tour legs, residencies
- Any quotes about plans or travel
- How recent this information appears to be
- Source credibility assessment

Be concrete and factual. Discard unrelated content.

assess.prompt:
Target: {target_name}

New findings:
{raw_findings}

All prior intelligence:
{prior_findings}

Synthesize a current location assessment:
- Most likely current location (city/country)
- Confidence: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW
- Next confirmed public appearance (date + city if known)
- Next 2 weeks schedule (if known)
- Key evidence and sources
- Remaining gaps

decide.prompt:
Iteration {iteration} complete. Tracking: {target_name}

Current assessment:
{location_assessment}

Stop (reply NO) only if ALL of these are true:
- Current location confirmed with HIGH confidence
- At least 2 weeks of upcoming schedule is known
- Multiple independent sources agree

Otherwise reply YES to keep searching.
